purpose: Issue65 coauthor occurrence/disposition preparation; no source re-evaluation or independent final review
scope: All 157 tracked files at baseline; each registered ID plus names/title/URLs/distinctive values; each C01-C33 cluster. Broad queries intentionally contain false-positive terms; hits are not assertions.

active_incoming_brief_link_audit.method: Resolve local Markdown brief links in reader/evidence bodies; exclude indexes, bookkeeping, own-source and explicitly preserved history; check against declared supplying-source current_use. This structural check complements manual inspection of indirect/uncited uses.

findings.finding: Existing active brief navigation absent from registry and brief current_use

reproduction.baseline_materialization: git ls-tree -r --name-only BASELINE; git show BASELINE:path for each manifest path into a separate directory; filenames and SHA256 checks in manifest
reproduction.classification: Path classes below plus exact source-history and integration-section cutoffs; they classify locations, not truth or assertion polarity.
reproduction.binary_behavior: Manifest includes all tracked bytes; ripgrep default binary handling applies, so binary images are not treated as current prose. Counts are match lines per query, with duplicates across queries.
